comparisons.reason: Different constructs: item 0 flags any comment citing a specific identifiable real-world example (event, person, case, study) as support. Item 1 flags any comment using abstract reasoning (general principles, logic, conceptual argument) not grounded in personal experience. A comment can have either without the other, and abstract reasoning is judged independently of anecdotes or examples. They share the source column and the any/binary/null rules, but the extraction predicates differ.
